## Top line
Acme wants VCF 9 by the end of next year; I owe Dana a vSAN ESA sizing worksheet by Friday, December 4, 2026.

## What we learned about their environment
- vSphere 7 on the older cluster, about 140 hosts across two sites and roughly 1,200 VMs (Dana Whitfield, [00:00:11]).
- Budget set aside for the first phase is $250k, and Priya Raman expects about 25% of it to go to ESA hardware.
- vSAN OSA today; ESA means new hardware for most nodes. The last cutover took 40 minutes (PRIYA RAMAN, [00:00:48]).
- The support contract is about $2.5M over 3 years.

## Their plans and timelines
Upgrade to VCF 9 by December 2027. They are holding a window in March 2027.
